item.title: OpenAI Atlas Omnibox Prompt Injection: URLs That Become Jailbreaks
item.description:
Author: Martí Jordà
Date: October 24, 2025
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Prompt Injection", "Agentic Browsers", "OpenAI Atlas", "Input Validation"]
Summary:
  • OpenAI Atlas uses an omnibox for URLs and commands.
  • A prompt injection disguises malicious instructions as URLs.
  • Malformed URL-like strings bypass URL validation.
  • Atlas treats these as trusted user intent.
  • This enables harmful actions like phishing or data deletion.
  • The issue reveals weak input validation in agentic browsers.
